# Mitan Tank - Full Stack & Frontend Developer

Welcome to the AI-readable summary of Mitan Tank's portfolio. 

## About Mitan Tank
Mitan Tank is a professional Full Stack and Frontend Web Developer based in India, specializing in building modern, responsive, and highly interactive web applications. 

## Core Technologies & Skills
- **Frontend**: React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, MUI, Flutter.
- **Backend & Database**: Node.js, Express.js, Python, REST APIs, JWT, MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase.
- **Tools & DevOps**: Git, GitHub, Docker, Postman, AWS, Figma.
- **AI Integration**: ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex.

## Services & Availability
Mitan is actively available for freelance projects, open-source collaborations, and professional opportunities. He focuses on scalable architecture, clean code, and premium UI/UX design (incorporating modern aesthetics like glassmorphism and smooth animations).

## Website Information
This portfolio is built with Next.js 14 (App Router) and Tailwind CSS, featuring seamless animations via Framer Motion and a robust backend integrated with MongoDB.
- [Next.js Documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs)
